apps.localizedDescription:
Matcha Moment is a calm, cream-and-green recipe app for matcha lovers.

• Six complete recipes: Traditional Usucha, Iced Matcha Latte, Honey Oat Matcha Latte, Strawberry Matcha Latte, Sparkling Yuzu Matcha, and Matcha Chia Pudding
• Every recipe lists ingredients, prep time, servings, difficulty, step-by-step instructions, and a barista tip
• A featured recipe that rotates every day
• Tap Surprise Me for a random recipe
• Favorites are saved on your device and work fully offline

Requires iOS 27 or later.
